text:
- **Go pm is the only implementation:** Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents no longer contain Python pm. The harness suite checks only Go pm. Go pm now has a new release. pm-harness now lives in Yeeef/pm, with its full history. The Linux server's clone runs Go pm and syncs with GitHub.
- **Owner-request hook:** The hook uses one rule in its prompt, judge, and reprompt. Autopilot is now the default mode. The owner decided against an interactive mode.
- **Site reading and records sync:** The site no longer shows "no such file" errors during a records sync. Wide diagrams stay readable on a phone and scroll sideways. Images kept beside a record now display on the site.
- **Release notes and CI:** Every release now has a structured release note from its changelog section. CI refuses a pull request or tag without one. The slowest CI check now finishes much faster.
